name: a progressive stream: what it has received at its freshest against the clock, no saw-tooth between chunks
paused with the connection open: the live point moves on, the offset grows by the pause
stalled (nothing arrives): the offset grows by the stall instead of falling with the buffer
a playhead that went back is a new connection: measured again
a source with a clock (HLS program dates, a live window): the player's own reading
a long pause with a full buffer (the edge frozen): the live point is kept, the offset grows by the whole pause
one read after a long pause nobody read: the edge brought nothing timely, the live point is kept
the live point falls (the source hiccuped upstream): followed once 60 s of audio has arrived since
a source with a clock, paused: its offset grows, its live point holds, it settles
a source with a clock at rate 2: its offset falls, its live point holds, it settles
a live window that slides (ExoPlayer HLS/DASH): the position drops by a segment, the stream's clock does not; it stays settled
